questions.question: A country's export price index rises from 100 to 126 while its import price index rises from 100 to 105. Calculate its terms of trade and state whether they have improved or deteriorated. (4 marks)
Explain two factors that may cause a deterioration in a country's terms of trade. (4 marks)
Analyse two factors that may change the pattern of trade between countries. (6 marks)
Examine the impact of an improvement in a country's terms of trade on its export revenues and its balance of trade. (8 marks)
Evaluate the view that specialisation and free trade always raise a country's living standards. (20 marks)
Explain the difference between a free-trade area and a customs union. (4 marks)
Explain two effects of imposing a tariff on an imported good. (4 marks)
Analyse two costs to a country of joining a trading bloc. (6 marks)
Examine the impact of a tariff on consumers, producers and the government. (8 marks)
Explain two ways in which the WTO supports trade liberalisation. (4 marks)
Analyse two reasons why a government might restrict free trade. (6 marks)
Evaluate whether a country should join a customs union. (20 marks)
